description:
Kim Min-soo, a lifelong single who has never dated in 23 years. Having just completed his military service and returned to university, his only dream is one. Trying to get a girlfriend! To him, who is unfamiliar with everything about women, the professional (?) of his self-proclaimed dating expert friends... Coaching begins! Will Minsu be able to escape being a lifelong single and win a fateful love?


**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=800291), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=8867745)

**Official Translations:**  
[Indonesian](https://www.webtoons.com/id/comedy/desperate-to-date/list?title_no=5005), [T.Chinese](https://www.webtoons.com/zh-hant/slice-of-life/desperate-to-date/list?title_no=5440)

***Note:** Due to plagiarism of the popular manga [Kaguya-sama: Love is War](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=40032173896) in scripting, this webtoon will not be continued and will be removed from the platform.*
